editorial:
Imagine a world of knights, bow and arrows, and a brave hero fighting against a greedy prince. You get all of that in this classic adventure. You follow the Earl of Huntingdon, a guy who loves the high life and winning jousts until everything goes wrong. When King Richard leaves for war, his brother Prince John takes over and starts treating everyone terribly. You will love seeing the main character turn into the legendary Robin Hood, gathering a group of loyal friends in the woods to steal from the rich and give to the poor while trying to win over the beautiful Lady Marian.

Even though it is an old silent film, the action is surprisingly snappy and the stunts are impressive for the time. You might find the lack of talking a bit slow at first, but the visual storytelling keeps you hooked. It is a great pick for anyone who enjoys old-school heroism and grand settings. To get the best experience, you should look for a restored version.
endingExplained: The story wraps up with a huge battle where Robin and his merry men finally take down Prince John's forces. King Richard returns from the Crusades just in time to stop the madness and reclaim his throne. Robin is forgiven for his crimes because he stayed loyal to the true king. He finally gets to be with Lady Marian, and peace is restored to the land as the bad guys are locked away.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old movies and classic hero stories.
